name: gap_scan_start_impl
prototype: void *gap_scan_start_impl(int adapter, const void *params, const int *block, const void *callbacks)

ownership.argument: This is the scan-start producer and it fixes the two block sizes: the parameter block is 8 bytes (4-byte word plus one flag byte) and the second block is 20 bytes of which 16 are consumed.

provenance.source: Allocates a 616-byte scan object, stores the callbacks pointer at object+12, then builds the adapter command message on the stack (zeroed, 708 bytes) and fills it from the two caller blocks: the message keeps *(u32 *)params at message+68 and *(u8 *)(params+4) at message+76, and the four dwords of the second block at message+80/+84/+88/+92. It then issues adapter command 237 through 0xC3AC47C and copies the 8-byte reply from message+12 into the scan object. Two callers.
